subject: Security & compliance follow-up: SOC 2, questionnaire, and roadmap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Thompson <daniel.thompson@healthcore.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-08T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + next steps (SOC 2 / questionnaire)

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our demo and the security discussion, and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum:  

1) Current ask from HealthCore: evaluate Redwood for production inference of PHI-adjacent workflows and confirm controls for HIPAA and SOC 2 scope.
2) You mentioned you’d like our latest SOC 2 report and to kick off your vendor security questionnaire.
3) You’re also interested in our roadmap for ISO 27001 and any plans around FedRAMP (longer-term).

Proposed next steps:  
- I’ll send over our SOC 2 Type II (redacted) and a short compliance roadmap doc outlining SOC scope, ISO timeline, and FedRAMP considerations — Rishi will add the technical details.
- If you can, please share the vendor questionnaire (or let us know if you prefer a DocuSign/OneTrust link).
- Quick 30-min follow-up early next week to review the questionnaire and map controls to your requirements.

Attaching the questionnaire stub you referenced would be helpful.

Thanks — look forward to continuing this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this message

From: Daniel Thompson <daniel.thompson@healthcore.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@healthcore.com>
Date: 2027-03-08T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (SOC 2 / questionnaire)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the clear next steps. A few quick clarifications from our side:  

- We do handle PHI under BAA with some of our vendors; our security team will need to validate encryption, access controls, and audit trails.
- We prefer to send a PDF vendor security questionnaire (attached). Please fill it out and return; if easier, we can accept a link to a secured drive with the artifacts.
- Timeline: target internal decision for a pilot by end of Q2.

I’ve attached the questionnaire and a short list of required artifacts (SOC 2 report, pentest summary, data retention policy). Can you confirm whether Redwood maintains separate SOC scope for production vs. sandbox environments? Also: any existing attestations for ISO 27001?

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, IT Security — HealthCore

Attachments: HealthCore_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Thompson <daniel.thompson@healthcore.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-09T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (SOC 2 / questionnaire)

Hi Daniel —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the questionnaire. I’ve routed this to our security team and pasted Rishi (our Head of Compliance) to respond with artifacts and details.

Quick answers up front:  
- SOC scope: Our current SOC 2 Type II (report attached) covers our hosted production inference platform and key operational controls. Sandbox/dev environments are excluded from the Type II scope; we can provide architecture diagrams and process docs for dev environments separately.
- ISO 27001: currently in scoping and gap analysis; target for certification submission in H2 2027.
- FedRAMP: evaluating feasibility for FedRAMP Low as a longer-term option for customers in regulated federal programs — no formal timeline yet.

Next steps:  
1) Rishi — can you complete the questionnaire sections related to controls, encryption, retention, incident response, and provide the SOC attachment?
2) Daniel — once you receive the completed questionnaire, can we schedule a 30-min control review the week of Mar 15?

Thanks —
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Thompson <daniel.thompson@healthcore.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-10T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Completed: questionnaire + compliance roadmap highlights

Hi Daniel / Marissa —

Thanks — I’ve completed the questionnaire sections we own and uploaded the artifacts to the secure drive link below. High-level notes:  

- SOC 2: Attached is our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redwood-soc2-type2-2026.pdf). The report covers production inference, identity and access management, change management, and incident response controls.
- Dev/Sandbox: as Marissa noted, dev environments are not in the Type II scope. We maintain separate access controls and anonymization scripts; we can produce process docs if you’d like them included in your vendor package.
- ISO 27001: gap analysis completed in Jan 2027; target to submit for audit in Q4 2027 and certify by mid-2028. Key focus areas for us: formalized ISMS, vendor risk program expansion, and control mappings for cryptography and logging.
- FedRAMP: exploratory discussions with a third-party assessor underway; likely multi-quarter effort if pursued.

Artifacts uploaded: redwood-soc2-type2-2026.pdf, pen_test_summary_2026.pdf, data-retention-policy.pdf (drive link below). I’ve answered the questionnaire fields inline in the PDF and added comments where we need clarifications from HealthCore on retention windows.

Secure artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSECURITYDOCS
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/HC-2027-04

If helpful, I’m available Fri Mar 12 or Tue Mar 16 for the 30-min control review — please propose a time.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-soc2-type2-2026.pdf, pen_test_summary_2026.pdf, data-retention-policy.pdf
